fields.question: What fabric is used?
fields.answer: Fabric details are listed in the product description and details tab — most Tredific® pieces use cotton, rayon, silk, or modal blends.

fields.question: Is the fit oversized or regular?
fields.answer: Default fit is regular / true-to-size. If you're between sizes we recommend sizing up. See the size chart on the product page.

fields.question: What is the delivery time?
fields.answer: India: 4–7 business days standard, 1–3 days express. International (US/UK/CA): 7–14 days standard, 3–6 days express.

fields.question: Can I return or exchange this?
fields.answer: Yes — we offer 30-day returns and free size exchanges on unworn items in original packaging. See the Return Policy in the footer.

fields.question: Is COD available?
fields.answer: Cash on Delivery is available across India for orders up to ₹10,000. International orders are prepaid only.

fields.question: How do I choose the right size?
fields.answer: Use the size chart modal on each product page — measurements are listed in inches for bust, waist, and hip across XS to 7XL.

fields.title: About Us
fields.body:
# About Tredific

## Built For The Bold

Tredific is a modern fashion and streetwear brand created for individuals who want to express confidence, individuality, and style through premium everyday fashion.

We focus on oversized fits, luxury-inspired streetwear, premium essentials, and trend-driven collections designed for the new generation of fashion lovers.

Our mission is simple:

> Deliver premium-quality fashion with modern aesthetics at accessible pricing.

---

## Our Story

Tredific was started with a vision to redefine everyday fashion in India by combining:

- Modern streetwear culture
- Luxury fashion aesthetics
- Comfortable oversized fits
- Premium fabric quality
- Minimal yet powerful designs

We noticed a gap between expensive luxury brands and low-quality fast fashion. Tredific bridges that gap by offering stylish, premium, and comfortable fashion that feels exclusive yet affordable.

---

## What Makes Tredific Different?

### Premium Fabric Quality
Every product is designed using comfortable and durable fabrics that feel premium for daily wear.

### Oversized & Modern Fits
Our collections are inspired by modern global fashion trends loved by Gen-Z and streetwear enthusiasts.

### Trend-Driven Designs
We constantly follow evolving fashion trends to deliver fresh and relevant styles.

### Minimal Luxury Aesthetic
Our brand philosophy revolves around clean, bold, and timeless fashion.

---

## Our Vision

We aim to become one of India's leading premium streetwear and fashion brands by delivering:

- Better fashion experiences
- Premium product quality
- Customer-first service
- Trend-focused collections
- Affordable luxury fashion

---

## Customer Commitment

At Tredific, customer satisfaction is our priority.

We are committed to:
- Secure shopping
- Fast delivery
- Easy returns
- Transparent policies
- Responsive customer support

---

## Join The Tredific Community

Fashion is more than clothing — it is self-expression.

Tredific is built for creators, dreamers, trendsetters, and bold personalities who believe confidence starts with what you wear.

Thank you for being part of our journey.
fields.meta_title: About Tredific® | Premium Streetwear & Oversized Fashion Brand
fields.meta_description: Learn about Tredific — a modern Indian streetwear and oversized clothing brand delivering premium fashion, luxury aesthetics, comfort, and trend-driven styles for Gen-Z and modern youth.

fields.body:
# Return & Exchange Policy

We aim to ensure a smooth and reliable shopping experience for all customers.

---

# Return Eligibility

Products may be eligible for return if:

- Returned within the allowed return window
- Unused and unwashed
- Original tags and packaging intact
- Not damaged after delivery

---

# Non-Returnable Items

Certain items such as clearance products or personalized products may not qualify for return.

---

# Exchange Process

Size exchanges are subject to product availability.

---

# Refund Timeline

Approved refunds are generally processed within 5–7 business days.

---

# Damaged or Wrong Products

If you receive damaged or incorrect items, contact support immediately with product images and order details.

---

# Return Abuse Prevention

Repeated fraudulent return behavior may result in account restrictions.

fields.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
fields.body:
# Shipping Policy

## Order Processing

Orders are usually processed within 24–72 business hours after successful payment confirmation.

---

## Delivery Timelines

Estimated delivery timelines:
- Metro cities: 3–7 business days
- Other locations: 5–10 business days

Delivery times may vary during sales, holidays, or high-demand periods.

---

## Shipping Charges

Shipping charges are calculated based on:
- order value
- delivery location
- active promotions

Free shipping may be available on eligible orders.

---

## Order Tracking

Once your order is shipped, tracking details will be shared via:
- Email
- SMS
- WhatsApp (if applicable)

---

## Delayed Deliveries

Delays may occur due to:
- weather conditions
- courier issues
- public holidays
- remote locations

We appreciate your patience in such cases.

---

## International Shipping

International shipping availability may vary based on location and customs regulations.

Additional customs duties or taxes may apply depending on the destination country.

---

## Incorrect Address

Customers are responsible for providing accurate delivery information.

Tredific is not responsible for failed deliveries caused by incorrect addresses.

fields.title: FAQ
fields.body:
# Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

## Orders & Payments

### What payment methods do you accept?
We accept UPI, debit cards, credit cards, net banking, wallets, and secure online payments through Razorpay.

### Is Cash on Delivery (COD) available?
COD availability depends on your location and selected products.

### Can I cancel my order?
Orders can only be canceled before dispatch. Once shipped, cancellation may not be possible.

---

# Shipping & Delivery

### How long does delivery take?
Orders are usually delivered within 3–7 business days depending on your location.

### Do you offer international shipping?
Currently, selected international regions are supported.

### How can I track my order?
You can track your order using the Track Order page and your order ID.

---

# Returns & Exchanges

### Can I return a product?
Yes, eligible products can be returned within the return window mentioned in our return policy.

### How do exchanges work?
Size or product exchanges are available based on stock availability.

---

# Product & Sizing

### Are your oversized t-shirts true to size?
Yes, product size charts are available on every product page.

### Will product colors vary slightly?
Minor color variations may occur due to lighting and screen differences.

---

# Account & Security

### Is my payment information secure?
Yes. All transactions are processed through secure encrypted payment gateways.

### Do I need an account to place orders?
No, guest checkout may be available. However, creating an account provides a better shopping experience.

---

# Contact Support

For further help, contact our support team through the Contact Us page.

fields.body:
# Brand Rules & Guidelines

Welcome to Tredific — a modern premium streetwear and fashion brand focused on delivering bold fashion, elevated essentials, and high-quality apparel experiences.

Our brand guidelines ensure consistency, authenticity, and customer trust across all products, visuals, communication channels, and customer experiences.

---

# Our Brand Vision

Tredific represents confidence, individuality, and premium streetwear culture. We focus on creating fashion that blends luxury aesthetics with everyday comfort for modern fashion enthusiasts.

Our goal is to provide:

- Premium oversized fashion
- Modern streetwear aesthetics
- High-quality fabric standards
- Trend-driven collections
- Customer-first shopping experience

---

# Product Quality Standards

Every product listed on Tredific follows strict quality checks before dispatch.

Our quality standards include:

- Fabric durability testing
- Premium stitching quality
- Comfortable fitting standards
- Modern fashion-forward designs
- Accurate product representation

We continuously work to maintain premium apparel standards for all customers.

---

# Content & Visual Standards

All product visuals, banners, and promotional materials are carefully designed to reflect the Tredific brand identity.

Our design principles include:

- Clean luxury aesthetics
- Modern typography
- Minimal visual clutter
- Authentic product representation
- High-quality imagery

Unauthorized use, copying, or reproduction of our brand assets is strictly prohibited.

---

# Customer Experience Standards

We are committed to delivering a smooth and transparent shopping experience.

This includes:

- Secure checkout process
- Fast customer support
- Transparent policies
- Reliable shipping updates
- Safe payment gateways

Customer trust remains our highest priority.

---

# Social Media & Community Guidelines

We encourage positive engagement across all our social media platforms.

Users must avoid:

- Hate speech
- Spam
- Fake reviews
- Offensive content
- Misleading claims

Tredific reserves the right to remove inappropriate content or restrict misuse of our platform.

---

# Intellectual Property

All logos, brand assets, graphics, product visuals, content, and website materials belong exclusively to Tredific unless otherwise stated.

Unauthorized usage or reproduction is prohibited under applicable intellectual property laws.

---

# Sustainability Commitment

We believe in responsible fashion practices and continuously explore better packaging, sourcing, and operational improvements to reduce environmental impact.

---

# Contact Us

For brand partnerships, media inquiries, or compliance concerns, contact us through our official support channels.

Thank you for supporting Tredific.

fields.title: Top Ethnic Fashion Trends for 2026
fields.excerpt: From minimalist silk drapes to maximalist mirror work — here's what's defining ethnic wear in 2026.
fields.body:
## Less is more, but make it heirloom

2026 is the year of quiet luxury in ethnic wear. Think soft silks, hand-block prints, and silhouettes that breathe.

## The fits that matter

Co-ord sets continue to dominate, with sharara and palazzo pairings back in rotation. Boxy kurta cuts feel fresh against fitted bottoms.

## Colours of the season

Wine, mustard, sage, ivory — palettes that flatter on every skin tone and read well on camera.

## Styling tip

Pair an embroidered kurta with sneakers for daytime, swap to juttis for evening. The same outfit, two moods.

fields.title: How to Style a Kurta Set Three Ways
fields.excerpt: One co-ord set, three completely different looks — from brunch to wedding-evening.
fields.body:
## The base outfit

Start with a printed cotton-silk kurta set — the kind of piece that earns its keep season after season.

## Look 1 — Brunch

Hair down, gold studs, juttis. Layer a thin chain. Done in five minutes.

## Look 2 — Office

Tuck the kurta loosely, add a cropped blazer, swap to closed-toe loafers. The same set now reads polished.

## Look 3 — Wedding evening

Pull out a contrast dupatta with mirror work, add statement earrings, and step into block heels. Sudden glamour.

## The takeaway

A great kurta set isn't an outfit — it's a wardrobe.

fields.title: The Care Guide: Making Your Ethnic Wear Last
fields.excerpt: Hand wash, line dry, low iron — and a few less-obvious habits that double the life of your favourite pieces.
fields.body:
## Wash less, wash gentler

Most ethnic wear doesn't need a wash after every wear. Spot-clean and air-out between wears to preserve fabric structure.

## Storage matters

Heavy lehengas should be wrapped in muslin and stored flat. Sarees are best folded along different seams every few months to prevent permanent creasing.

## The ironing rule

Always iron on the reverse, on the lowest heat that gets the job done. For embroidery, cover with a clean cotton cloth before pressing.

## When in doubt

Hand wash cold. Always.
